facts.title: Shared geographic filing and civil office procedures

filing_location.summary: AO2.080/20-1: civil filing division tied to defendant/respondent residence, cause-of-action accrual or property location. Lower Keys through west end Spanish Harbor Bridge; Middle through east end Channel Five Bridge; Upper through Key Largo/mainland. Presiding judge may use another courthouse without reassignment; consult original boundaries.

proposed_orders.summary: AO2.088: Portal, Word.docx/DJMCA, JPEG referenced exhibits, cover letter identifying circulation and agreement/no objection within five business days/specific objection. Removes certificate-of-service requirement; parties remain responsible for service. Avoid complex formatting; Arial or Times New Roman.

case_management.summary: AO3.010 assigns complex/general/streamlined tracks, subject to Rule1.200 exceptions, using attached forms for general/streamlined cases. Plaintiff serves management order on new parties, files notice and emails case manager. Order references applicable conferral; individual litigation schedules not abstracted.

stated_dates.local_rule6_effective: Upon Supreme Court approval; approval date not shown

review_scope.collected: Four original PDFs, extracted text and renders; manual LocalRule6 excerpt and visual date notes.
review_scope.content_reviewed: Geographic filing/courthouse rules; proposed-order office formatting; general case-management/service provisions; LocalRule6 divisions and conditional effectiveness.
review_scope.not_reviewed: Individual scheduling templates, specimen order substance, deposition-specific details, detailed criminal/family litigation.

conflicts.summary: AO2.088 April2026 removes certificate-of-service requirement and specifies JPEG referenced exhibits; May2023 memo still linked by profiles includes optional JA certificate and earlier formatting. Sources retained without deciding controlling authority.
